description: This Java class `CheckLoanRepaymentDueBusinessStep` is part of the loan processing module in the Apache Fineract project. It implements a business step to check if any loan repayment is due on a specific date, and if so, triggers an event notification. The class interacts with loan entities, repayment schedules, configuration settings, and event services to perform its logic.

classes.name: CheckLoanRepaymentDueBusinessStep
classes.description: A business step component that checks whether loan repayments are due soon and triggers corresponding events within the loan lifecycle.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method executing the check for upcoming loan repayment due dates, notifying events if criteria are met.

methods.name: getEnumStyledName
methods.description: Returns a string representing the enum-style identifier for this step.

methods.description: Returns a human-readable description of this business step.

methods.name: isDueEventNeededToBeSent
methods.description: Helper method determining whether a due date event should be triggered based on loan status, date calculations, and outstanding amounts.
